notes: Desktop unit (no rackUnits). Source: RME's official Babyface Pro FS User's Guide PDF (rme-audio.de/downloads/bface_pro_fs_e.pdf), cross-checked against rme-audio.de/babyface-pro-fs.html and rme-usa.com/babyface-pro.html product pages. USB device-side connector is a right-angle USB Type-B socket (confirmed by manual's package contents: "Cable USB 2.0 A plug to right angle B plug" and "Cable USB 2.0 C plug to right angle B plug", and by RME selling BF2USBC as an optional replacement cable rather than a hardware revision); grade set to usb-2.0 since RME states "When connected to USB 3, only the USB 2 protocol will be used." Optical TOSLINK is bidirectional ADAT/SPDIF; no grade applied since TOSLINK is not one of the graded connector families per the grading rules. Power connector is a locking round DC barrel jack (RME's proprietary locking type); closest listed id is dc-barrel. XLR mic inputs also function as line inputs at 0dB gain + PAD (up to +19dBu). Panel layout per RME's own description: XLR in/out on rear; TS instrument inputs 3/4 and both headphone jacks on right side; optical I/O, USB, power, and MIDI mini-DIN on left side.
